description: Telerik UI for ASP.NET Core provides server-side helpers for Kendo UI's JavaScript framework. It enables developers comfortable with the ASP.NET Core framework to easily configure and work with Kendo UI via familiar server-side programming, instead of relying solely on hand-coding of HTML and JavaScript.
title: Telerik UI for ASP.NET Core
